s.note: Pippin's idea that hobbits need a second breakfast
s.how: Grill 8 rashers of bacon and fry 250g mushrooms in butter. Grill 2 halved tomatoes. Toast 8 slices white bread and butter with marmalade. Serve on a big platter mid-morning. What about elevenses?

s.note: the hobbits raid Farmer Maggot's crop
s.how: Remove the stems from 4 large field mushrooms. Mix 50g breadcrumbs with 2 crushed garlic cloves, thyme, 80g grated gruyère and 30g melted butter. Pile into the caps and roast at 200C for 15 minutes until bubbling.

m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, add 2 onions, thyme and 375ml dark ale and braise 2.5 hours. Thicken, pour into a dish, top with puff pastry and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter and 300g peas.

w.note: an old-fashioned Shire cake for elevenses
w.how: Beat 175g butter with 175g sugar, add 3 eggs, then fold in 225g self-raising flour, 2 tsp caraway seeds and 3 tbsp milk. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes. Slice thick and spread with butter.

d.note: it comes in pints at the inn in Bree
d.how: Leave four 500ml bottles of English ale out of the fridge for an hour to reach cellar temperature. Pour into proper pint glasses. Pour cloudy apple juice into half pints for anyone smaller. It comes in pints?
